title: Add product search
description: Adds GET /api/products/search?q= for the storefront search box. It finds products whose name contains the term, ignoring case, newest first, at most 50. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The search term is put straight into the SQL string passed to `$queryRawUnsafe`, so `q` can inject SQL (for example `' OR 1=1 --`, or a UNION reading the User table's password hashes). Use a tagged `$queryRaw` template or `findMany` with `contains`.
